evidence: remote-message-lands-in-the-host-tree: listener_simple.conf.epp:16 x509/certvalid accepts any CA-signed client cert; the probe sends an RFC3164 line (host p8testremote, tag p8test) over TLS with the node's Puppet-CA-signed cert, and the effect expects it once in /var/log/hosts/p8testremote/p8test.log, which is what lines 18-23/34-35 (log_root default /var/log + hostname + programname + .log) produce

listener-config-rendered: listener_simple.conf.epp:12-14 render port/maxSessions/notifyOnConnectionClose; class defaults 6514, 2000, false (-> 'off' by the selector on line 14) match the expected port="6514", maxSessions="2000", notifyOnConnectionClose="off"; cert/key named after $trusted['certname'] (puppet8node) and the /var/log/hosts/ constant twice (lines 19 and 27) also match

the-retention-script-compresses-and-deletes: rsyslog-hosts-retention.sh.epp:30-34 delete *.gz not newer than RETENTION_DAYS (7) days ago, so older.log-20200101.gz (mtime 10 days) goes and newer.log-20200102.gz (mtime 2 days) stays; lines 12-26 gzip+touch p8test.log-<10 days ago> (date < 6 days ago) so its fresh .gz survives the delete, and leave the 2-day one; expected listing newer...gz, p8test.log-NEW, p8test.log-OLD.gz is exactly that
